title: Treatment costs in India | TIB HIND
description: Honest treatment costs in India for heart surgery, cancer, transplants, orthopaedics and IVF. NABH and JCI accredited hospitals only. Your written figure within 48 hours.
lede: We show what treatment in Delhi NCR really costs — as honest ranges, not fixed quotes. Every case is priced on its own, and the figure for yours comes in writing within 48 hours.
heroBody: The same procedures cost a fraction of US, UK and European prices, performed in NABH and JCI accredited hospitals to international standards. TIB HIND is paid by the hospitals, never by you.

solid.label: Get a figure for my case

cta.note: Free. No obligation. A written opinion within 48 hours.

facts.d: Including a cost figure for your own case
Varies with the procedure
Accredited hospitals only, every time

sections.label: Overview
ps: Each range below covers the full package we negotiate for you: the surgeon and hospital fees, your room, standard medicines, ICU time where needed, basic tests, an interpreter and your medical visa invitation letter.
It does not include flights, hotels for family, or medicines that are not part of the standard protocol. You will see every line on an itemised invoice.
ul: ICU time where the procedure needs it

sections.label: Why ranges
sections.h: Why we quote ranges, not fixed prices
ps: Two people having the same named surgery can have very different needs — your anatomy, your other conditions, the complexity of the procedure and your hospital stay all move the price.
That is why we never promise a fixed price up front. We give an honest range, then a written figure for your specific case after reviewing your records, usually within 48 hours.

sections.label: Your figure
sections.h: How the written opinion gives you a figure
ps: Send us your reports and scans. A TIB HIND physician reviews them and a hospital quotes for exactly what your case needs — the result is a written opinion with a cost figure for you, not a brochure range.
The figure is a single package price that covers the treatment itself. If the treatment changes because of new findings, we tell you before anything is done — never after.
ul: Review of your records by our team
A single package figure, in writing

costsNote: Ranges are typical for Delhi NCR in 2026. The figure for your own case comes in writing within 48 hours.
costsFooter: All prices in USD, inclusive of hospital and surgeon fees for the standard package. Your exact figure depends on your case and is confirmed in writing before travel.

faq.q: Why can't you give me one fixed price?
faq.a: Because your case is specific. The same surgery costs differently depending on your anatomy, other health conditions, the complexity of the procedure and how long you need to stay. We give an honest range up front, then a fixed package figure for you after reviewing your records.

faq.q: Are there hidden charges?
faq.a: No. The written opinion states what the package covers, and the hospital invoice is itemised line by line. If your treatment changes because of new findings, we agree the cost with you before anything is done.

faq.q: Who pays TIB HIND?
faq.a: The hospitals pay us — you never do. Our fee is built into the hospital price, so you pay only for treatment, not for our guidance, translation or visa support.

faq.q: Why does the range change with my type of cancer?
faq.a: Because the treatment is different. The drugs, the number of cycles, whether you need surgery and how long you stay all depend on the type and stage of your disease. The range helps you budget; the written opinion prices your case.

faq.q: Are the chemotherapy drugs the same brands as home?
faq.a: Your oncologist prescribes from the same international drugs and follows standard protocols. The package lists exactly which drugs are covered, and anything outside that is agreed with you before use.

faq.q: Can the figure change mid-treatment?

lede: Brain and spine surgery in Delhi NCR is performed by experienced neurosurgeons at NABH and JCI accredited hospitals, at a fraction of Western prices. These ranges are honest estimates — your figure comes in writing within 48 hours.
heroBody: Neurosurgery is priced around the complexity of your lesion and the technology it needs — awake surgery, neuronavigation or a coiling suite. Your MRI and angiogram decide the true figure.

solid.label: Get a figure for my case

cta.note: Free. No obligation. A written opinion within 48 hours.

facts.d: Including a cost figure for your own case
Included in the package
Your scans reviewed before pricing

sections.label: Overview
ps: The package covers the surgeon and hospital fees, your room, ICU time, standard medicines and basic tests, an interpreter and your medical visa invitation letter.
It does not include flights, family hotels, or consumables outside the standard protocol — and the invoice is itemised.

sections.label: Why ranges
ps: A small surface tumour and a deep lesion near speech areas are very different operations. Whether your aneurysm is coiled or clipped, and whether devices are needed, drives the price.
After reviewing your MRI and angiogram with the neurosurgeon, we confirm a fixed package figure in writing.
ul: Location and size of the lesion

sections.label: Your plan
ps: Send your MRI, CT or angiogram. Our team matches you to a neurosurgeon who operates on your condition regularly, and the package is quoted for your scan, not a template.

faq.q: Why is deep brain stimulation so much more?
faq.a: Because the pacemaker-like device and the stereotactic planning technology dominate the cost. The surgery itself is skilled work, but the implant is the expensive part — and it is quoted in full, in writing.

faq.q: Can my aneurysm be coiled instead of clipped?
faq.a: Often, yes, and the figure depends on which is safer for your anatomy. Your angiogram is reviewed before pricing, so the package matches the procedure you will actually have.

faq.q: How long will I need to stay?
faq.a: Most patients are in hospital 5–8 nights and remain in Delhi for a short follow-up visit. The exact plan is written into your opinion before you travel.

Implants such as screws and cages are listed separately on the invoice — you always see what you are paying for.

sections.label: Why ranges
ps: A one-level fusion and a scoliosis correction of the whole spine are entirely different operations. The number of levels, the metalwork needed and your bone quality all change the cost.
Your MRI is reviewed with the surgeon before a fixed package figure is confirmed in writing.

sections.label: Your plan

faq.q: Why are the implants a separate line?
faq.a: Because metalwork — cages, screws and rods — can be a large part of the bill and differs with every construct. We list it separately so you see exactly what you pay for, and it is included in your confirmed package.

faq.q: Will I need physiotherapy after?
faq.a: Yes, and it is built into your plan. The written opinion includes the follow-up visits before you fly home, so your recovery does not add surprise costs.

faq.q: Can I avoid surgery with injections?
faq.a: Sometimes. If a nerve block or epidural is genuinely an option, your surgeon will tell you — the figure for the procedure you actually need is quoted, not the most expensive one.

title: Bone marrow transplant cost in India | TIB HIND
description: Bone marrow transplant cost in India: autologous, matched sibling and haploidentical. Honest USD ranges at NABH and JCI accredited hospitals. Written figure in 48 hours.
h1: Bone marrow transplant cost in India
lede: A bone marrow transplant is one of the most complex treatments available, and in Delhi NCR it costs a fraction of Western prices. These ranges are honest estimates — your figure comes in writing within 48 hours.
heroBody: The cost turns on the type of transplant: using your own stem cells, a matched sibling's, or a haploidentical donor. Conditioning drugs, ICU days and complications dominate the bill.

solid.label: Get a figure for my case

cta.note: Free. No obligation. A written opinion within 48 hours.

facts.d: Including a cost figure for your own case
In hospital for the transplant
For a matched family donor

sections.label: Overview
ps: The package covers the transplant team and hospital fees, your room, conditioning chemotherapy, stem cell infusion, ICU and isolation care, standard drugs and tests, an interpreter and your medical visa invitation letter.
The cost is dominated by the long hospital stay and drugs — this is why the range sits well above other treatments.
ul: Conditioning chemo and stem cell infusion

sections.label: Why ranges
sections.h: Why the type of transplant matters
ps: An autologous transplant re-infuses your own stem cells and is the least complex. An allogeneic transplant from a matched sibling needs stronger conditioning and longer support. Haploidentical — half-matched — adds further complexity.
Your condition, donor availability and previous treatment are reviewed before a fixed figure is confirmed in writing.

sections.label: Your plan
ps: Send your diagnosis, previous chemotherapy history and blood work. Our team matches you to a transplant centre and the haematologist reviews your case before pricing.
You receive a written opinion with the figure, the full transplant timeline and a visa letter for you and your donor.

costsNote: Ranges are typical for Delhi NCR in 2026, for the full transplant admission. The figure for your case comes in writing within 48 hours.
costsFooter: Prices in USD, inclusive of the full transplant admission. Complications and non-standard drugs are managed and agreed with you before additional cost is incurred.

faq.q: Why is a transplant so expensive compared to other surgery?
faq.a: Because it is weeks of intensive care, not an operation. Conditioning chemotherapy, isolation nursing, the stem cell product and drugs for graft and infection all run alongside the bed — and every day of that is included in your quoted package.

faq.q: Does my donor need to travel too?
faq.a: A matched sibling donor usually does. We arrange visa invitation letters for both of you, and donor screening is included in the package so there are no surprise costs.

faq.q: What if I get an infection after the transplant?
faq.a: Infections are the most common complication, which is why the isolation room and supportive care are built into the package. If extended care is needed, it is discussed with you before the cost is incurred.

faqTitle: Questions about bone marrow transplant cost

title: Organ transplant cost in India | TIB HIND
description: Kidney, liver and heart transplant cost in India. Honest USD ranges for living and deceased donor transplants at NABH and JCI accredited hospitals. Written figure in 48 hours.
lede: Kidney, liver and heart transplants in Delhi NCR cost a fraction of Western prices, performed by experienced transplant teams at accredited hospitals. These ranges are honest estimates — your figure comes in writing within 48 hours.
heroBody: The donor type drives the cost: a planned living donor transplant with a matched relative is usually the most affordable and safest route. Deceased donor transplants add waiting and coordination costs.

solid.label: Get a figure for my case

cta.note: Free. No obligation. A written opinion within 48 hours.

facts.d: Including a cost figure for your own case
For the recipient
Screening and surgery for living donors

sections.label: Overview
ps: The package covers the transplant team and hospital fees, your room, ICU, the donor's evaluation and surgery where a living donor is used, immunosuppression drugs for the first period, basic tests, an interpreter and your visa invitation letter.
Immunosuppression beyond the included period, flights and family hotels are quoted separately.

sections.label: Why ranges
sections.h: Why the donor type changes the price
ps: A planned living donor transplant from a relative is the most cost-effective and can be scheduled. A deceased donor transplant avoids a living donor but adds coordination and longer waiting and stay.
Your kidney or liver function, the donor's health and the transplant centre's protocol are all reviewed before a fixed figure is confirmed.

sections.label: Your plan
ps: Send your current blood work, imaging and dialysis records. Our team matches you to a transplant centre and the transplant physician reviews your case before pricing.
You receive a written opinion with the figure, the transplant timeline and visa letters for you and your donor.

costsNote: Ranges are typical for Delhi NCR in 2026, for the full transplant admission. The figure for your case comes in writing within 48 hours.
costsFooter: Prices in USD, inclusive of the transplant admission and donor care where applicable. Long-term immunosuppression beyond the package is quoted separately.

faq.q: Can my relative be my donor?
faq.a: In most cases, yes. A living donor transplant from a family member is usually safer and cheaper than a deceased donor transplant, and donor evaluation is included in the package. The transplant team checks compatibility and safety first.

faq.q: What happens with my dialysis during the wait?
faq.a: Your dialysis is managed by the transplant centre from arrival, and it is included in the quoted package for the pre-transplant period. There are no hidden daily charges.

faq.q: Do I need to stay long after the transplant?
faq.a: Recipients usually stay two to four weeks in hospital, then a follow-up period in Delhi. The written opinion includes the post-transplant visits before you fly home.

heroBody: Most routine gastro surgery is keyhole, which shortens the stay and the bill. Liver and pancreatic resections are major surgery — complexity and ICU days drive those costs.

facts.d: Including a cost figure for your own case

Where it is safe for your case

sections.label: Overview
ps: The package covers the surgeon and hospital fees, your room, standard medicines and tests, ICU time where the operation needs it, an interpreter and your medical visa invitation letter.
Laparoscopic instruments and disposables are included, and the invoice shows every line.

sections.label: Why ranges
ps: A keyhole gallbladder removal is a short stay with modest cost. A pancreatic resection can take hours, involve ICU days and a longer recovery — the range reflects that gap honestly.
Your imaging is reviewed with the surgeon before a fixed package figure is confirmed in writing.

sections.label: Your plan
ps: Send your ultrasound, CT or endoscopy reports. Our team matches you to a gastrointestinal surgeon and the package is quoted for your scans.
You receive a written opinion with the figure, the surgical plan and a visa letter before you travel.

costsNote: Ranges are typical for Delhi NCR in 2026. The figure for your own case comes in writing within 48 hours.
costsFooter: Prices in USD, inclusive of hospital and surgeon fees for the standard package. Your exact figure depends on your case and is confirmed in writing before travel.

faq.q: Is keyhole surgery always the option?
faq.a: Where it is safe, yes — it means a shorter stay and a lower bill. For complex resections an open approach may be safer, and the quote you receive is for the operation you will actually have.

faq.q: Why is pancreatic surgery so much more expensive?
faq.a: Because it is major surgery — often hours on the table, ICU days and a longer recovery. The range reflects that honestly rather than quoting a low figure that rises later.

faq.q: Do I need special preparation before travelling?
faq.a: The written opinion tells you exactly what to bring and what to expect, including your blood group, allergies and current medicines. Nothing is left to guesswork.

lede: Weight-loss surgery in Delhi NCR costs a fraction of Western prices, performed laparoscopically at accredited hospitals. These ranges are honest estimates — your figure comes in writing within 48 hours.
heroBody: The sleeve and the bypass are different operations with different long-term care. Revisional surgery for someone who has had a previous procedure costs more because the anatomy is more complex.

solid.label: Get a figure for my case

cta.note: Free. No obligation. A written opinion within 48 hours.

facts.d: Including a cost figure for your own case
Laparoscopic, most cases
First post-op visits before you fly home

sections.label: Overview
ps: The package covers the bariatric surgeon and hospital fees, your room, standard medicines and tests, dietitian sessions during your stay, an interpreter and your medical visa invitation letter.
The preoperative evaluation that confirms you are a candidate for surgery is also part of the pathway.

sections.label: Why ranges
ps: The sleeve is a simpler, shorter operation than the bypass. Revisional surgery means operating on someone who has already been operated on — scar tissue and changed anatomy make it slower and costlier.
Your BMI, other conditions and previous surgery are reviewed before a fixed figure is confirmed in writing.

sections.label: Your plan
ps: Send your height, weight, medical history and any cardiac or diabetes reports. Our team matches you to a bariatric surgeon, and a package is quoted after the pre-op evaluation.
You receive a written opinion with the figure and a visa letter before you travel.
ul: Medical history reviewed by our team

costsNote: Ranges are typical for Delhi NCR in 2026. The figure for your own case comes in writing within 48 hours.
costsFooter: Prices in USD, inclusive of hospital and surgeon fees for the standard package. Your exact figure depends on your case and is confirmed in writing before travel.

faq.q: Do I qualify for surgery?
faq.a: Bariatric surgery is for people with significant obesity, usually with a BMI above a level your surgeon will confirm, especially with diabetes or heart risk. The pre-op evaluation settles it honestly — surgery is not pushed on anyone.

faq.q: Why is revisional surgery more expensive?
faq.a: Because it is a second operation on an already-changed anatomy. It takes longer, needs more skill and carries a longer stay — the range reflects that, and the package is confirmed before you travel.

faq.q: Is the dietitian included?
faq.a: Yes — nutrition sessions during your stay are part of the package, because the surgery works only with the eating plan that follows it.

title: IVF cost in India | TIB HIND
description: IVF cost in India: IVF cycle, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, and PGT-A testing. Honest USD ranges at accredited fertility centres. Written figure in 48 hours.
lede: Fertility treatment in Delhi NCR costs a fraction of Western prices while matching international laboratory standards. These ranges are honest estimates — the figure for your cycle comes in writing within 48 hours.
heroBody: Your age, your ovarian reserve, whether ICSI is needed and whether you use donated eggs or sperm all change the cost. The clinic's lab accreditation matters more than marketing.

solid.label: Get a figure for my case

cta.note: Free. No obligation. A written opinion within 48 hours.

facts.d: Including a cost figure for your own case
From stimulation to embryo transfer
Also Bengali — spoken on-site

sections.label: Overview
ps: A typical package covers stimulation medication, monitoring scans and blood tests, egg retrieval, laboratory fertilisation, embryo culture and transfer, and the embryologist's time. An interpreter and visa letter are included.
Donor egg or sperm, PGT-A genetic testing and embryo freezing for future cycles are quoted separately or as add-ons.

sections.label: Why ranges
sections.h: Why the cost varies between patients
ps: A standard IVF cycle assumes your own eggs are fertilised with your partner's sperm. ICSI adds a lab step for male-factor cases. Using donated eggs or sperm adds donor costs, and PGT-A adds genetic testing on top.
Your hormone profile and any previous cycles are reviewed before a fixed figure for one cycle is confirmed.
ul: Own or donated eggs and sperm

sections.label: Your plan
ps: Send your hormone reports, ultrasound and any previous cycle history. Our team matches you to an accredited fertility centre and the clinic confirms a package for one cycle.
You receive a written opinion with the figure and a visa letter before you travel.
ul: Fixed price per cycle in writing

costs.name: IVF with egg or sperm donation

costsNote: Ranges are typical for Delhi NCR in 2026, per cycle. The figure for your case comes in writing within 48 hours.
costsFooter: Prices in USD per cycle. Frozen embryo transfer in a later cycle, and medications beyond the standard protocol, are quoted separately before you commit.

faq.q: Does the price include medication?
faq.a: The stimulation medication is included in the package for the standard dose your protocol needs. If your dose is unusually high, the difference is agreed with you before the cycle starts.

faq.q: What if a cycle fails?
faq.a: The package covers one complete cycle as stated. If you have frozen embryos, a frozen transfer in a later cycle costs far less than a fresh cycle — that figure is quoted transparently, with no pressure to continue.

faq.q: Is PGT-A testing necessary?
faq.a: Not for everyone. It is recommended in some cases, such as advanced maternal age or repeated failed cycles. We present it as an option with its cost, and the decision stays with you and your doctor.

title: What is included in a TIB HIND cost | TIB HIND
description: Exactly what a TIB HIND treatment package covers and what it does not: surgeon and hospital fees, room, medicines, ICU, tests, translator and visa letter — itemised, no hidden charges.
h1: What is included in your cost
lede: Before you compare quotes, know what they contain. This page sets out exactly what a TIB HIND package covers, what it does not, and how the invoice is itemised — so there are no surprises.
heroBody: The package price we confirm in writing is the price for your planned treatment. Every line appears on an itemised invoice, and anything beyond the plan is agreed with you before it is done.

solid.label: Get a figure for my case

cta.note: Free. No obligation. A written opinion within 48 hours.

facts.d: Including a cost figure for your own case
Every line shown, in your language
No guidance fees on your bill

sections.label: Included
ps: The written package price covers the surgeon and hospital fees, your room, nursing care, standard medicines, ICU time where the procedure needs it, and the basic tests your treatment requires.
It also covers an interpreter so you always understand what is happening, and the medical visa invitation letter for the countries TIB HIND supports.
ul: Standard medicines and ICU where needed

sections.label: Excluded
ps: Flights, hotels for family members and everyday meals are outside the package, as is any non-essential drug or test your doctor does not consider part of the standard protocol.
Complications are the one thing no honest quote can fully price in advance. If one arises, we discuss the plan and its cost with you before proceeding — never after.
ul: Complications — agreed with you as they occur

sections.label: Invoice
ps: You receive a line-by-line invoice in a language you understand, covering the hospital, the surgeon, the room, medicines, tests and any ICU days. It matches the package we confirmed in writing.
Because the hospitals pay TIB HIND, there is no guidance fee, translation fee or service charge on your bill — you pay for treatment only.

faq.q: Are there hidden charges?
faq.a: No. The written opinion states what the package covers, and the hospital invoice is itemised line by line in your language. Anything beyond the confirmed plan — a non-standard drug, a longer stay, a complication — is agreed with you before any cost is incurred.

faq.q: Do I pay TIB HIND anything?
faq.a: No. The hospitals pay us, never you. Your bill covers your treatment and the itemised items listed on it — our guidance, translation and visa support are not charged to you.

faq.q: What if the invoice shows more than the package?
faq.a: Tell us immediately. The invoice must match the written package. Any difference should only reflect an item you agreed to add beforehand — if it is unexplained, we resolve it with the hospital before you pay.
